name: jang-lecture-rebuilder
description: Browser-first PPTX, PDF, and HTML lecture redesign tool deployed on Cloudflare Pages.

scripts.dev: npm run build && wrangler pages dev dist --compatibility-date=2026-07-23
scripts.check: node --check app-v2.js && node --check extractor-v2.js && node --check source-importer.js && node --check ocr-engine.js && node --check fallback-plan.js && node --check pptx-exporter.js && node --check pptx-exporter-v2.js && node --check lecture-template.js && node --check html-design-contract.js && node --check master-design-reference.js && node --check functions/api/config.js && node --check functions/api/redesign.js && node --check functions/api/redesign-large.js && node --check functions/api/design-html.js && node --check scripts/build.mjs && node --check tests/create-fixtures.mjs
scripts.test:e2e: npm run build && npm run test:fixtures && playwright test
scripts.test: npm run check && npm run unit && npm run test:e2e
